summary: A Global HR Professional with 10+ years of progressive experience across industries and geographies, specializing in project management, HR business partnering, and building HR programs aligned with business strategy to drive successful results.

education.degree: Master of Industrial and Labor Relations
education.institution: Cornell University, School of Industrial and Labor Relations

experience.title: Global HR Manager
responsibilities: Managed the Technical Leadership Program (TLP) across multiple countries, partnering with senior leaders and HR business partners.
Designed and led cross‑functional HR projects such as Flight Risk Analysis, Technical Development Global Career Framework, and Global Job Family Architecture.
Facilitated global engagement survey deep‑dive sessions and redesigned manager development programs.
Rolled out mentoring and learning nomination processes for top talent development.
Oversaw data analysis and project support for a team of HR analysts and interns.

experience.title: Global HR Analyst
responsibilities: Developed and implemented staffing processes for Global TLP associates in China, India, and Brazil.
Provided online training support for technical knowledge, management skills, and language learning.
Organized global HR monthly leadership meetings and facilitated performance calibration and merit planning.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Analyzed competency gaps and designed action plans for an IT off‑shoring project in India.
Redesigned organizational structure and hiring strategies for a new manufacturing plant in Germany.
Created global engagement survey analysis reports for multiple regions.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Managed diverse HR functions for a client base of over 300 employees, including staffing, training, and labor relations.
Designed recruitment strategy and staffed over 200 positions across headquarters and R&D labs.
Utilized SAP HRIS for personnel changes and improved data accuracy with automated reports.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Implemented HR practices for 2,200+ sales employees across 45 regional offices in China.
Developed performance evaluation and salary negotiation plans.
Coordinated annual salary reviews, compensation analysis, and incentive adjustments.
